concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-online-payments-account-updater-batch-account-updater]] — Adyen Batch Account Updater guide (webpage snapshot, 2026-09-15) for SFTP or scheduled single-card requests, encrypted batch result files, and follow-up stored-card actions.
warnings: The single-card API Success response confirms request receipt; the outcome remains in a batch result file and the route is distinct from Real Time Account Updater.
Disabled-card notification does not remove Adyen token references; merchant deletion is required. Stored-detail update through a payment request needs Support enablement.
